_comment: REDACTED SAMPLE — the default `cosign sign-blob --key cosign.key --bundle` output from the 2026-06-17 run (cosign v3.1.1, windows/amd64). Cryptographic values (signatures, digests, hashes, checkpoint, canonicalizedBody) are replaced with '<redacted:...>' placeholders; they came from a throwaway demo keypair and are not reproducible. The EVIDENCE this file carries is STRUCTURAL: a key-based sign-blob bundle contains not only publicKey but also tlogEntries (a public rekor.sigstore.dev entry) AND timestampVerificationData (a public TSA timestamp). That is the post's central finding — 'signed with a key' does NOT mean 'offline'. Re-run ./run.sh to regenerate a real bundle and diff its verificationMaterial keys.
